zh: 一个频率要通过全部滤波器，就必须同时落在每个闭区间里；多个闭区间的交集仍然是一个闭区间（可能为空），所以不必对每个频率逐一检查 m 个区间。
交集的左端点是所有区间左端点的最大值，右端点是所有区间右端点的最小值；若左端点大于右端点，交集为空，答案为 0。之后只需判断每个频率是否落在这一个区间里。
读入 n、m 和 n 个频率；扫描 m 个区间，求出 lo=最大左端点、hi=最小右端点；再遍历所有频率，统计满足 lo≤x≤hi 的个数并输出。总时间 O(n+m)。
en: A frequency passes every filter only if it lies in every closed interval at once; the intersection of closed intervals is again a single closed interval (possibly empty), so there is no need to test each frequency against all m intervals.

The intersection starts at the maximum of all left endpoints and ends at the minimum of all right endpoints; if the start exceeds the end, the intersection is empty and the answer is 0. After that you only need to test each frequency against this one interval.

Read n, m and the n frequencies; scan the m intervals to get lo = the largest left endpoint and hi = the smallest right endpoint; then go over all frequencies, count those with lo <= x <= hi, and print the count. Total time O(n+m).

explanationEn:
## Approach

The intersection runs from the largest left endpoint to the smallest right endpoint; traverse the frequencies and count those that fall within this closed interval.

## Proof of correctness

A number satisfies all intervals if and only if it is not smaller than any lower bound and not larger than any upper bound.

## Complexity

O(n+m) time, O(1) extra space.
